outcomes.focus: Classify and measure assets held for sale, discontinued operations

outcomes.focus: Separate disclosure of material items of income or expense
outcomes.check: Material disclosures distinguished from excluding an ordinary payroll expense

outcomes.focus: Accounting-policy changes, accounting-estimate changes and prior errors
outcomes.check: Retrospective policies/errors versus prospective estimates; remaining carrying $60,000 divided by three years is $20,000

outcomes.focus: Basic and diluted earnings per share, bonus, rights, convertibles and options
outcomes.check: Bonus comparative denominator 187,500 -> EPS $1.60; standalone convertible $1.65; TERP $4.60; treasury stock incremental 8,000 shares
